incidente.resumo: A bug introduced on September 30 in LaunchDarkly's frontend code caused an error page when using the rule attribute selector on the flag targeting page, in environments where one or more private attributes had been declared within a LaunchDarkly SDK. The change was reverted, restoring full functionality.

descricao.texto: Some customers were seeing an error page when attempting to use the attribute selector on the flag targeting page.
trechos: Some customers are seeing an error page when attempting to use the attribute selector on the flag targeting page.

descricao.texto: A bug introduced on September 30 in the frontend code caused an error page to be displayed when using the rule attribute selector (the first dropdown when creating or editing a targeting rule), only in environments where one or more private attributes had been declared within a LaunchDarkly SDK.
trechos: On September 30 we introduced a bug in our frontend code that resulted in an error page being displayed when attempting to use the rule attribute selector (the first dropdown when creating or editing a targeting rule).
This bug only affected environments where one or more private attributes had been declared within a LaunchDarkly SDK.

fatores_contribuintes.texto: Tests did not cover the case of private attributes for this component, so the bug was not caught earlier in the development cycle.
trechos: Our tests did not cover the case of private attributes for this component, which is why the bug was not caught earlier in our development cycle.

descricao.texto: A change to the frontend code of the rule attribute selector, introduced on September 30.
trechos: On September 30 we introduced a bug in our frontend code that resulted in an error page being displayed when attempting to use the rule attribute selector (the first dropdown when creating or editing a targeting rule).
Once we became aware of the issue we were able to revert the change and restore full functionality.

passos.texto: Reverted the change, restoring full functionality.
trechos: Once we became aware of the issue we were able to revert the change and restore full functionality.

acoes.texto: In progress: implementing unit tests and integration tests that exercise this and other frontend code when private attributes are in use.
trechos: Going forward, we are implementing both unit tests and integration tests that will exercise this and other frontend code when private attributes are in use.

observacoes: The text does not say when the bug reached production, only that it was introduced on September 30; the status updates run from 14:00 (Investigating) to 14:30 PDT (Resolved) on Sep 30, 2021, so the impact duration cannot be computed.
